milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining an oak_door in survival mode causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_door item (only a wooden_axe), so having ≥1 oak_door in inventory confirms the door was actually broken/mined rather than merely opened by right-clicking. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak_button (recipe: 1 oak plank in crafting table) places the resulting item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_button, so having ≥1 confirms the craft was completed successfully. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks since the crafted item ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.
